maddeler.e:
تيوسرت (form VI)
# تُيُوسِرْتُ (tuyūsirtu) /tu.juː.sir.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُيُوسِرْتَ (tuyūsirta) /tu.juː.sir.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُيُوسِرْتِ (tuyūsirti) /tu.juː.sir.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُيُوسِرَتْ (tuyūsirat) /tu.juː.si.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
